purpose: Describe a thought or action that occurs unexpectedly.
keywords: ふと + perception / thought / small action
I suddenly thought of an old friend.
I happened to look out the window and saw snow falling.
On my way home, I stopped without thinking.
formation: ふと + perception / thought / small action
restrictions: Often a brief unplanned moment, rather than a deliberate decision.
mistake: 突然 emphasizes abruptness; ふと often emphasizes lack of intention.
